segments.content: WLOG sort a₁ < a₂ < ... < aₙ (by applying a permutation)——通过排序把一般情形归约到有序情形
Let x = a₁ + ... + a_{n-1} (sum of all but the largest element)——定义关键变量x为除最大元外所有元素之和
We proceed by strong induction on n——确立强归纳框架
Three cases based on the position of M's elements relative to x——以x为分类标准做三情况分析
Case 1 (x ∈ M and ∃ y ∈ M with y > x): Then n ≥ 3——Case 1前提与边界条件
Among the n-1 small elements, define 'bad' index i if x - aᵢ ∈ M or s - aᵢ ∈ M——定义坏指标概念
The map from bad indices to M\{x} is injective (x - aᵢ maps to M\{x} since x ∈ M and aᵢ > 0; s - aᵢ > x so maps to M∩(x,∞))——坏指标到M\{x}的单射论证
Since |M\{x}| = n-2, there are at most n-2 bad indices among n-1 total, so at least one good index r exists with x - aᵣ ∉ M and s - aᵣ ∉ M——计数论证得到好指标r的存在性
Let t = x - aᵣ, M' = M ∩ (-∞, t]. Then |M'| ≤ n-3 (since both x and y are excluded from M')——构造归约集M'并验证规模缩减
Apply induction to the n-2 remaining elements (excluding aᵣ and aₙ) with M', getting permutation p'——对缩减后的问题应用归纳假设
Construct the full permutation: place p' first, then aᵣ, then aₙ (with a swap to put aₙ second-to-last)——构造完整排列，使用swap技巧调整aₙ位置
All prefix sums before aᵣ are ≤ t and avoid M'; the sum up to aᵣ is s - aₙ = s - aᵣ - (sum of rest) which avoids M by choice of r; the final sum is s ∉ M——验证所有前缀和规避M
Case 2 (x ∉ M and ∃ y ∈ M with y > x): Then |M ∩ (-∞, x]| ≤ n-2——Case 2前提与M的规模分析
Let M' = M ∩ (-∞, x]. Apply induction to a₁,...,a_{n-1} with M' (sum = x ∉ M')——构造M'并对前n-1个元素应用归纳
If M' is empty, use identity——M'为空时使用恒等排列作为基础情形
Otherwise get permutation p', extend by placing aₙ last——非空时取归纳排列p'并把aₙ放最后
All prefix sums of first n-1 jumps are ≤ x and avoid M'; the final sum is s ∉ M——验证前缀和规避M
Case 3 (all m ∈ M satisfy m ≤ x): Let z = max(M), M' = M\{z}——Case 3前提，定义z并构造M'
Apply induction to a₁,...,a_{n-1} with M' (|M'| = n-2). Get permutation p'——对前n-1个元素应用归纳得到p'
If some prefix sum of p' equals z at position k, swap position k with the last position: place aₙ at position k (jumping over z since aₙ > a_{p'(k)}), and place a_{p'(k)} last——命中z时用swap技巧让aₙ跳过z
If no prefix sum equals z, p' already avoids all of M (since M = M' ∪ {z} and z is never hit)——未命中z时p'已规避全部M
The general case (unsorted a) is reduced to the sorted case by composing with the sorting permutation——一般情形通过排列复合归约到有序情形
